head_connector.pin_definition: Project logical numbers assigned by mated-pair continuity and labels, NOT assumed manufacturer cavity order or wire colors. Supply-side female contacts. Spare insulated separately at both ends.

usb_access.notes: 기판 상단과 USB 포트 전면을 막지 않음. 외함 CAD/헤더 높이/케이블 몰드 실측 별도. 닫힌 외함에서 끝까지 삽입·충전·업로드 검사는 납품 조건.

mounting.notes: 고정홀 주변 미사용 패드는 제거/절연. 나사·너트·스페이서 외경은6.5mm이하. 외함 고정 좌표는 실물 대조.
mounting.consumables: NT-KIT-E018 M3 mainboard: 10mm standoffs x4 minimum; NT-KIT-E017 M2 small modules: 5mm standoffs x6 allowance; 100mm ties x10 allowance; 18x18 tie mounts x6 allowance
mounting.enclosure_conditions: OLED/button common frame and final case require measured fabrication; supplied hardware is not the frame. USB native port face flush to exterior aperture; no obstructing ledge; actual cable fit test required.
mounting.wire_note: AWG24 insulated loose jumpers. Drawing lines are routing guides, not literal wire diameter. At dense crossings lift insulated wires in height; verify actual OD, solder bridges and case clearance.

changes: Battery display and divider omitted; D10 unconnected
Sense expansion left intact: no resistor removal or J3 cut
Boot buzzer chirp accepted for MVP
Factory NW pigtails and SM 2P+4P head cables replace manual crimping
Loose wiring unified to AWG24; factory cable gauges retained
Ground branches retained using GJ1/GJ2 bare junction pads

sense_modification.scope: Sense camera/SD expansion remains as supplied. No resistor removal, no J3/JP3 cut. SD card absent; no SD/shared SPI initialization. D10 intentionally unwired. D9 boot beep accepted.

P_BAT: Direct solder AWG24 before XIAO mounting; individual insulation; NW2 factory pigtail at carrier end
P_SW: Direct solder AWG24 to labeled module pads; NW3 factory pigtail at carrier end; no ON/SW_EXT connection
P_B1: Individually insulated soldered pigtail; fixed connector body; NW2 factory pigtail at carrier end
J4: 2.54mm male header on P2; CH254 female pigtails; splice to labeled NW4 factory pigtail harness. P1 Gravity port unused
J5: CH254 individual female pigtails on existing 2.54mm header; arrange by actual silkscreen; NW4 factory pigtail at carrier end
J6: SH1.0-4P factory pigtail; cut Dupont end and splice to NW4 factory pigtail harness; continuity-map cavities, ignore wire colors
J7: Four CH254 female pigtails on A signal column only; NW4 factory pigtail at carrier end; do not use + or - columns
J8: SW1 / SW2 / SW3 NO contacts and common ground
Solder existing button contacts; insulate each; NW4 factory pigtail at carrier end; frame carries button force
J9: Three CH254 female pigtails on labeled module header; NW3 factory pigtail at carrier end; 3.3V supply, active HIGH
J2: JH_E SM2 pair: logical1 E1 / 2 E2
NW2 factory pigtail -> insulated solder splice -> SM2 factory pigtail pair -> dry electrode terminals
J3: JH_T SM4 pair: logical1 +3V3 / 2 DQ / 3 GND / 4 NC
NW3 factory pigtail -> insulated solder splice -> SM4 factory pigtail pair -> DS18B20; spare individually insulated both ends
J10: Solder switch contacts and individually insulate; NW4 factory pigtail at carrier end
P_SVC: XIAO existing BOOT GPIO0 side / RESET EN side
Fixed short insulated soldered leads before mounting; identify signal side by continuity; no extra plug

battery_display.charging: Native USB-C charger and protected battery path retained; no battery percent or voltage UI

ground_junctions.GJ1: 11-11, former R18 ground hole; bare solder junction, no component
ground_junctions.GJ2: 09-13, former C4 ground hole; bare solder junction, no component

firmware_change: setup(): digitalWrite(D9, LOW) before pinMode(D9, OUTPUT); boot chirp accepted, normal idle silent. Measurement and calibration otherwise unchanged. Firmware compile/flash not performed in this environment.
